en.editorNote: For the three-second pause after a coworker asks how you slept. It's about the hour that left no record behind, which is funnier than saying "I have insomnia."
variations: How many hours did I get? I don't have an answer, only an estimate.
3 to 4:30 is missing from the record and I wouldn't testify about it either.

items.sourceNote: Joke aggregator browsed for angles; the habitual under-reporting of your own bedtime to other people is original to this item — no existing item covers the daytime social cover-up

zh-tw.content:
同事問我昨天幾點睡，我聽見自己說「大概一點吧」。
實際上是三點四十。
不知道為什麼，講到睡覺時間我就會自動打折，
講完還多補一句：還好啦，睡得不錯。
中午之前，我對三個人講了同一個版本，
現在連我自己都快相信了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種在茶水間被問「你昨天幾點睡」就自動少報兩小時的人。笑點在那句沒人要求的補充說明，寫的是既不想被關心、也不想被念的那一秒。
variations: 我報出去的睡覺時間，跟實際數字之間有一段固定的匯差。
講出口的是一點，真正關燈的是三點四十，中間那兩小時我從來不申報。

en.content:
Underreporting my bedtime has become fully automatic.
A coworker asked what time I went to sleep and I heard myself say "around one."
It was 3:40.
Then I added, unprompted, that I'd slept pretty well.
Same version delivered to three different people before lunch.
I'm now two hours short in every conversation and slowly starting to believe it.
en.editorNote: For anyone who shaves two hours off the answer the second a coworker asks. The joke is the unrequested "slept fine" at the end — the second where you want neither concern nor a lecture.
variations: There's a fixed exchange rate between the bedtime I report and the one that happened.
I say one o'clock, the lights went off at 3:40, and those two hours go undeclared every time.

items.sourceNote: Original seasonal observation for a late-summer Sunday night; kept to what is audible from a bed, no external source used

zh-tw.content:
八月的週日深夜，我又醒著，但今晚有一點不一樣。
七月那批吵得讓人心煩的蟬，剩沒幾隻了，
接手的是草叢裡那種比較細、比較不急的聲音。
冷氣開到三點，我第一次覺得有點涼，起來把它關掉。
這幾個睡不著的晚上，我以為什麼都沒發生，
其實季節已經悄悄往前挪了一格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合週日凌晨兩三點還醒著、隨手把手機拿起來的那一刻。不勸睡，只遞一個窗外的變化過去：夏天正在退場這件事，通常是還醒著的人先發現的。
variations: 夏天要走的時候不會先通知，是睡不著的人最早聽出來的。
同一張床、同一個三點，只有窗外的聲音換了班。

en.content:
August Sunday nights sound different, and the awake ones hear it first.
The cicadas that ran all of July are down to a handful now.
Whatever lives in the grass has taken over the shift — thinner, less urgent.
Around three the AC finally felt cold, so I got up and switched it off.
I'd assumed nothing was happening on these sleepless nights.
The season moved a notch while I wasn't looking.
en.editorNote: For 2 or 3am on a Sunday, when you reach for your phone anyway. It doesn't tell anyone to sleep — it just hands over something happening outside the window, which the person still awake noticed before anyone else did.
variations: Summer doesn't announce its exit. The people who can't sleep hear it leaving first.
Same bed, same 3am, and only the sound outside has changed shift.

items.sourceNote: Background reading on sleep bruxism and night guards; used only as factual grounding, the scene and punchline are original

zh-tw.content:
牙醫翻了翻我的臼齒，說：你晚上咬得很用力。
我說：可是我晚上根本沒睡著。
他說：那你就是醒著咬。
最後他幫我做了一副咬合板，說可以保護牙齒。
牙齒有人保護了，
那個整晚咬緊牙關的我呢？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合早上起床下巴痠、太陽穴緊繃的那種人。從牙醫診間切入失眠，比直接說「我壓力大」好講出口，前面好笑、最後一句才把真心話放進去。
variations: 我不是磨牙，我是連躺著都在加班。
白天撐、晚上咬，我的下巴比我還累。

en.content:
The dentist poked around my molars and said, you clench hard at night.
I told him I don't actually sleep at night.
He said, then you clench awake.
He fitted me for a night guard, to protect the teeth.
Great — the teeth have someone looking out for them now.
What about the guy doing the clenching?
en.editorNote: For anyone who wakes up with a sore jaw and tight temples. Starting at the dentist's chair makes it easier to admit than saying "I'm stressed" outright — the laugh comes first, the honest part lands last.
variations: I'm not grinding my teeth. I'm working overtime lying down.
I brace all day and clench all night. My jaw is more tired than I am.

items.sourceNote: Coverage of popular folk sleep remedies (warm milk etc.) used as raw inspiration; the list, voice and ending are original

zh-tw.content:
我失眠的事一被知道，身邊每個人都變成專家。
姑姑說睡前喝一杯溫牛奶，同事說泡腳二十分鐘，
樓下阿姨叫我把床頭轉個方向，
群組裡還有人傳「這個呼吸法照做三天保證好眠」。
我全部都照做了。現在凌晨三點，
我腳很暖、床頭朝東、肚子裡有一杯牛奶，
而且非常清醒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被親友熱心建議轟炸過的人。不酸誰，只是把「大家都很有辦法、只有我還醒著」的荒謬寫出來，收到偏方轉發時可以直接回傳這則。
variations: 每個人都有一套治失眠的方法，只有我還醒著。
偏方我已經收集成一本了，就是沒收集到一個晚上的好覺。

en.content:
The moment people find out you can't sleep, everyone turns into an expert.
My aunt swears by warm milk. A coworker says soak your feet for twenty minutes.
The neighbor downstairs told me to turn my bed to face a different direction.
Someone in the group chat forwarded a breathing method, guaranteed in three nights.
I did all of it. It is now 3am.
My feet are warm, my bed faces east, there is milk in my stomach,
and I have never been more awake.
en.editorNote: For anyone who's been buried in well-meaning advice. It doesn't mock the advice-givers — it just lays out the absurdity of everyone having a fix except you. A fine reply to the next forwarded remedy.
variations: Everyone has a cure for insomnia. I'm the only one still awake.
I've collected a whole book of remedies and not one decent night.

items.sourceNote: Original scene built from the experience of reviewing an overnight sleep-recording app; no external text used

zh-tw.content:
我裝了一個會錄整晚的 App，只是想知道自己到底有沒有睡著。
早上打開，它標了六十四段。
有翻身、有嘆氣、有一段我完全不記得的自言自語，
還有三點四十七分，一聲很長的「唉」。
我重聽了三次，還是聽不出來那個人在唉什麼。
明明是我自己的聲音，卻像在偷聽一個陌生人的夜晚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種「查了一堆數據卻更不安」的睡眠焦慮。前半是笑點，最後一句把距離感留給讀者，適合半夜自己發、不特別想被安慰的時候。
variations: 錄了一整晚，只證明一件事：我真的醒著。
App 給了我六十四段證據，卻沒有一段說得出原因。

en.content:
I installed an app that records the whole night, just to find out whether I sleep at all.
By morning it had flagged sixty-four clips.
Rolling over. Sighing. A stretch of muttering I have no memory of.
And at 3:47, one long, tired sigh.
I played it three times and still couldn't tell what he was sighing about.
It's my own voice, and it felt like eavesdropping on a stranger's night.
en.editorNote: For the kind of sleep anxiety that gets worse the more data you collect. The first half is the joke; the last line leaves the distance sitting there. Good for posting at 3am when you don't especially want to be consoled.
variations: A whole night of audio proved exactly one thing: I was awake for it.
The app gave me sixty-four pieces of evidence and not one reason.

items.sourceNote: Original comfort piece using dark adaptation as its image; written for this topic, no source text

zh-tw.content:
剛關燈的那一秒，房間黑得什麼都看不見，
你會以為這一整夜大概就是這樣了。
但再躺個幾分鐘，天花板的邊會浮出來，
窗簾的縫、櫃子的角，一個一個回到位置上。
沒有人開燈，是你的眼睛自己慢慢適應了。
今晚也是這樣，你不用現在就看清楚全部，
有些事只要多待一會兒，就會自己變得沒那麼黑。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那種一睡不著就急著想弄懂原因的人。它不叫人放鬆、也不承諾睡得著，只提醒一件身體本來就會做的事：待久一點，眼睛會自己適應。
variations: 沒有人開燈，房間還是慢慢清楚了一點——那是你的眼睛做到的。
有些黑不是要你解決的，是要你多待一下的。

en.content:
The second you turn off the light, the room is solid black,
and it feels like that settles the whole night.
But lie there a few more minutes and the edge of the ceiling comes back.
The gap in the curtain, the corner of the wardrobe — each one returns to its place.
Nobody turned on a light. Your eyes adjusted on their own.
Tonight works the same way. You don't have to see all of it right now.
Some things get less dark simply because you stayed a little longer.
en.editorNote: Send this to the person who starts diagnosing themselves the moment sleep doesn't come. It doesn't tell them to relax or promise they'll drift off — it points at something the body already does on its own: stay a while, and your eyes adjust.
variations: Nobody turned on a light and the room got clearer anyway. Your eyes did that.
Some darkness isn't asking to be solved. It's asking you to stay a few more minutes.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by clock-checking humor in late-night social posts; rewritten around household appliances showing four different times

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點多，我開始核對時間。
手機說 3:07，床頭的鬧鐘說 3:14，
微波爐停在 2:58，電視旁邊那台盒子說 3:03。
四個時間，四種人生。
我躺著挑了微波爐那個來相信，
理由是：這樣我今晚還多九分鐘可以睡。
然後我花了二十分鐘，在心裡跟另外三台機器吵這件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡電器時間永遠對不準的人。傳給那個半夜會認真比對每一台機器的朋友，他一定懂那九分鐘的意義。
variations: 四台機器四個時間，我當然選對我最有利的那一個。
凌晨三點的我不是在看時間，是在挑一個我比較能接受的版本。

en.content:
A little past 3am, I started cross-checking the time.
My phone says 3:07. The clock by the bed says 3:14.
The microwave is stuck on 2:58, and the box under the TV says 3:03.
Four clocks, four different lives.
I decided to believe the microwave,
because that version gives me nine more minutes of sleep.
Then I spent twenty minutes arguing with the other three in my head.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose appliances have never once agreed on the time. Send it to the friend who genuinely audits every clock in the house at 3am — they'll know exactly what those nine minutes were worth.
variations: Four clocks, four times, and obviously I picked the one that favors me.
At 3am I'm not checking the time, I'm shopping for a version of it I can live with.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by the recurring 'is it getting light already' panic in sleep-struggle posts; rewritten around mistaking a streetlamp for dawn

zh-tw.content:
我盯著窗簾中間那條光縫。
它好像比剛剛亮了一點。
完蛋，天要亮了，我一整晚都沒睡。
伸手摸到手機：三點十一分。
那道光是對面那盞路燈，
它從我十一點躺下來就一直在那裡，
亮度一點都沒變。變的是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給那種一覺得「天好像亮了」就心臟一縮的人。它抓的不是睡不著本身，是那種你比整個夜晚還著急的心情。
variations: 那不是天亮，那是路燈。整晚在變的只有我。
凌晨三點的我，可以把一盞路燈看成一整個早上。

en.content:
I stared at the strip of light between the curtains.
It looked brighter than it did a minute ago.
Great. It's dawn and I never slept.
I felt around for my phone. 3:11am.
That light is the streetlamp across the road.
It has been there since I lay down at eleven,
exactly as bright as it was. The thing that changed was me.
en.editorNote: For the people whose stomach drops the second the room looks lighter. The joke isn't the sleeplessness — it's being in more of a hurry than the night is.
variations: Not the sunrise. A streetlamp. The only thing getting brighter tonight was my panic.
At 3am I can turn one streetlamp into an entire morning.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by insomnia posts that argue over sleep math; rewritten as a bureaucratic dispute about which day it currently is

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點半，我認真卡在一個行政問題上：
我現在還沒睡，那我算「今天熬夜」，還是「明天早起」？
如果四點睡、七點起，這算睡了三小時，
還是算我今天根本沒睡，只是打了個盹？
這題沒有標準答案，
但我很確定，我又用二十分鐘幫它找了三種算法。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在深夜群組，尤其群裡剛好有人也還在線上。重點從來不是答案，是那顆連「今晚」要怎麼定義都想吵一下的腦袋。
variations: 四點睡七點起，到底算睡了三小時，還是算根本沒睡。
我不是睡不著，我是卡在日期的行政程序裡。

en.content:
3:30am, and I'm stuck on a genuinely administrative question:
if I haven't slept yet, am I up late today or up early tomorrow?
If I fall asleep at four and get up at seven, is that three hours of sleep,
or did I not sleep at all and simply take a nap?
There is no official answer,
but I did spend twenty minutes finding three ways to calculate it.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the late-night group chat, ideally when someone else is still online. The point isn't the answer — it's the brain that has to litigate the definition of tonight before it will rest.
variations: Asleep at four, up at seven: three hours of sleep, or zero with a nap in it?
I'm not lying awake, I'm stuck in a paperwork dispute about what day it is.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by supportive framing in insomnia community posts; rewritten as permission to lower tomorrow's bar rather than any sleep advice

zh-tw.content:
三點四十，我算了一下明天的行程，
發現不管怎麼排，都換不回今晚。
那就別換了。
沒睡飽的那天，可以用另一套標準：
挑出真正不能挪的那兩件，做完就算及格，
其他的往後推，不會有什麼東西因此垮掉。
你不必在睡不好的一天，還要求自己跟平常一樣厲害。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在凌晨傳給那種「明天一定要照常表現」的朋友。它不保證你睡得著，只是先把明天的標準，調到一個你真的做得到的位置。
variations: 沒睡飽的那天，及格線可以自己往下調，這是你的權利。
明天把真正重要的那兩件做完就好，其他的可以等。

en.content:
3:40am. I ran the numbers on tomorrow
and there's no arrangement that wins tonight back.
So let's stop trying.
The day after a rough night gets to run on different rules:
pick the two things that genuinely can't move, finish those, call it a pass.
Everything else slides, and nothing falls apart.
You don't owe tomorrow the same version of you that slept.
en.editorNote: Good to send in the small hours to the friend who is determined to perform normally tomorrow. It doesn't promise them sleep — it just moves tomorrow's bar somewhere they can actually reach.
variations: On no sleep, you're allowed to lower the passing grade yourself.
Two things that actually matter, done. The rest can wait a day.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by 2026 普渡箱採購清單類文章；改寫成凌晨三點跟一箱還沒開的零食對看，不寫流程、不寫禁忌、不寫日期

zh-tw.content:
客廳那箱東西，比我早好幾天就定位了。
三種餅乾、兩排鋁箔包、一袋小包裝的泡麵，疊得整整齊齊。
凌晨三點我起來倒水，經過它，停下來。
我沒有拆，我只是把外包裝上的口味讀了一遍，
又蹲下去把箱子轉了個方向，讓字比較好看。
然後回房間躺下，繼續醒著。
它們還要等好幾天才上場，卻已經比我安穩。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡也堆著那一箱、半夜卻只有你醒著的時候發。配一張凌晨三點的紙箱照片剛好，重點是那箱東西看起來比你有規劃。
variations: 凌晨三點，我對那箱零食做的唯一一件事，是把它轉了個方向。
家裡什麼都各就各位了，只有我還在等今晚開始。

en.content:
Three kinds of crackers, two rows of juice boxes, one bag of single-serve noodles.
The box in the living room got itself sorted days before I did.
3am, on the way to the kitchen for water, I stopped in front of it.
I didn't open anything. I read every flavor on the packaging once,
then crouched down and turned the box so the label faced the room.
Back to my room. Still awake.
They don't go out for days yet, and they're already steadier than me.
en.editorNote: For the house that's fully stocked for the seventh month while you're the only thing in it still running. Works as a caption for a 3am photo of a suspiciously well-organized cardboard box.
variations: Turned the box so the label faced the room. That was the whole night.
Everything here is in position days early. Except me.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by sleep-struggle posts about households where more than one person is awake; rewritten as a wordless 3am kitchen encounter, no advice given

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點半我去倒水，發現廚房的燈已經亮了。
我媽站在流理台前，手上也是一杯水。
我們互相看了一眼，誰都沒問對方為什麼還醒著。
她把杯子放下，說：「櫃子裡有餅乾。」
我說好。
然後兩個人各自回房間，繼續各自的夜。
一個家有兩個人沒睡，聽起來很慘，
但那三十秒，是我今晚最不孤單的時候。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給同住、而且時差跟你一樣的家人。它不解決任何事，只是說出一件事：走廊另一頭那盞燈，跟你亮著的是同一種。
variations: 凌晨三點的廚房，兩個人，兩杯水，沒有人問為什麼。
我們沒有聊天，但那盞燈亮著的時候，夜就沒那麼長。

en.content:
3:30am, I went for water and the kitchen light was already on.
My mom was at the counter, holding a glass of her own.
We looked at each other. Neither of us asked why the other was up.
She set her glass down and said there were crackers in the cabinet.
I said okay.
Then we went back to our rooms and back to our separate nights.
Two people awake in one house sounds bleak,
but those thirty seconds were the least alone I felt all night.
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever in the house keeps the same hours you do. It fixes nothing — it just names the light down the hall as the same light you're standing in.
variations: Two people, two glasses of water, one 3am kitchen, zero questions.
We didn't talk. The night got shorter anyway.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by 2026 螢幕時間與睡眠的報導；改寫成跟手機週報「分類欄位」吵架，不談建議、不談時數對錯

zh-tw.content:
早上七點，手機推了一份週報給我：
這週的螢幕使用時間，平均每天多了兩小時十四分。
它還很盡責地幫我分好類，第一名是「娛樂」。
這個分類我不接受。
那兩小時我不是在娛樂，我是在等。
等一個怎麼樣都沒出現的東西，手上剛好有手機而已。
麻煩把那個欄位改成「等待」，謝謝。
全世界只有這支手機知道我幾點還醒著，
偏偏它一次都沒問過為什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合週一早上被手機統計打臉的時候發。重點從來不是那個數字，是它把那兩個小時放錯了欄位。
variations: 螢幕使用時間第一名：「娛樂」。我要求重新歸類。
凌晨兩點到四點不算娛樂，那一欄應該叫「等待」。

en.content:
Two hours and fourteen minutes more than last week, my phone reported at 7am.
It had sorted everything into categories. Top of the list: Entertainment.
I do not accept that classification.
I wasn't being entertained from two to four. I was waiting.
Waiting on something that never showed up, with a phone already in my hand.
Please relabel that column Waiting.
This phone is the only thing on earth that knows what time I'm still up,
and it has never once asked why.
en.editorNote: Post it the Monday your weekly screen time lands. The number isn't the insult — the category is.
variations: Screen time says Entertainment. I'm filing for a recount.
Two to four in the morning does not go under Entertainment. That column should read Waiting.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by sleep-struggle posts about sudden late-night bursts of energy; rewritten around a Taiwanese August downpour and a balcony laundry sprint

zh-tw.content:
凌晨兩點，外面的雨突然變大。
我從床上彈起來，衝到陽台，三分鐘把整排衣服收完，
動作精準、判斷果斷，完全不像一個躺了四小時沒睡著的人。
衣服全是乾的。
回到床上，心跳一百二，眼睛比出門前還亮。
所以我的身體不是沒有反應，
它只是不接受「睡覺」這一個指令。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合台灣八月那種半夜沒有預告就下起來的雨。給所有「什麼都做得到、就是睡不著」的人，配陽台照片效果最好。
variations: 半夜兩點的那場雨，是我今年反應最快的一次。
我的身體什麼指令都接，只有「睡覺」那一條不理我。

en.content:
2am, the rain came down hard.
Off the bed, onto the balcony, laundry in by minute three,
moving like someone who hadn't been lying awake for the last four hours.
Every shirt dry.
Back in bed: heart at 120, eyes wider than before I got up.
So the body does respond to instructions.
It just refuses the one I keep giving it.
en.editorNote: For the Taiwanese August nights that open up at 2am with no warning, and for anyone who can execute absolutely anything except falling asleep.
variations: Fastest I've moved all year: 2am, sudden rain, laundry off the line.
My body takes every instruction except the one about sleeping.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by writing on how deliberately trying not to think keeps you awake; rewritten as a short back-and-forth between a person and their own brain

zh-tw.content:
我：今晚什麼都不要想。
腦袋：好。
腦袋：先確認一下，「什麼都不要想」有包含高中那件事嗎？
我：包含。
腦袋：那你現在腦袋裡是不是已經有那件事了？
我：……
腦袋：這個我可沒有起頭喔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種「越叫自己別想越清醒」的夜晚。丟給同樣會躺在床上跟自己辯論的朋友，比一百句晚安還有用。
variations: 叫我不要想，等於幫那件事加了書籤。
我的腦袋其實很聽話，你說不要想什麼，牠就先幫你調出來確認一次。

en.content:
Me: tonight we are not thinking about anything.
Brain: Understood.
Brain: Quick check — does "anything" include that thing from high school?
Me: It does.
Brain: So is that thing in your head right now?
Me: ...
Brain: For the record, you brought it up.
en.editorNote: For the nights when telling yourself to stop thinking is the exact thing that wakes you all the way up. Send it to the friend who also argues with themselves in bed.
variations: Telling me not to think about it is just bookmarking it.
My brain is very obedient. Name the thing you don't want, and it pulls the file up to confirm.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by coverage of a Taiwanese social-media thread where strangers found comfort in being awake at the same time; rewritten around a gecko in an old apartment ceiling

zh-tw.content:
天花板角落那隻壁虎，每隔一陣子叫一聲。
我沒有回牠，但每一聲我都有聽到。
牠不是來吵我的，牠只是也還沒下班。
整間屋子都收工了，剩我們兩個各自守著自己那一塊。
有一個不用解釋、也不會問你為什麼還醒著的伴，
比任何助眠音檔都好用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合台灣老公寓的悶熱夏夜，房裡有壁虎在叫的那種晚上。想安慰在外租屋、睡不著又不想被追問的人時特別好用。
variations: 整棟樓都收工了，只剩我跟一隻壁虎還在上班。
牠叫一聲，我在心裡回一聲，這樣也算有人陪。

en.content:
There's a gecko in the ceiling corner, letting out a click every so often.
I never answer it, but I hear every single one.
It isn't there to bother me. It just hasn't clocked off either.
The rest of the house has shut down, and the two of us are holding our own corners.
Company that needs no explanation, and never asks why you're still up,
beats every sleep playlist I've downloaded.
en.editorNote: For humid nights in an old apartment with a gecko somewhere overhead. A gentle thing to send someone living alone who is awake and tired of being asked why.
variations: Whole building clocked off. Me and one gecko are still on shift.
It clicks, I answer in my head. That counts as company.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by explanations of why effortful sleep backfires; rewritten as a mock game manual with rules and a self-deprecating punchline

zh-tw.content:
睡覺這款遊戲，說明書大概是這樣寫的：
・沒有教學關卡，出生就直接上場
・每天只能挑戰一次，失敗當天不能重來
・唯一的操作方式是「放開手把」
・所有攻略都是贏過的人事後寫的，而他們也講不清楚自己怎麼贏
・輸的人反而可以寫出十頁心得
我心得寫最多，段數最低。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經試遍各種助眠方法、還是躺在那裡的人。當貼文最後一段自嘲收尾，留言區會冒出一堆同好。
variations: 這是我玩過唯一一款「你越認真操作，畫面越不動」的遊戲。
睡覺的攻略永遠由贏家執筆，偏偏贏家根本不知道自己做了什麼。

en.content:
If sleep shipped with a manual, it would read like this:
- No tutorial level. You're in the match from birth.
- One attempt per day. A loss cannot be replayed.
- The only control is letting go of the controller.
- Every guide is written by people who won, and not one of them can explain how.
- The people who lose can produce ten pages about it.
I have the most pages and the worst record.
en.editorNote: For anyone who has tried every sleep tip going and is still lying there. Works as a self-deprecating closer on a post — the replies write themselves.
variations: Only game I know where playing more carefully freezes the screen.
All the sleep advice comes from winners who have no idea what they did.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by memes about the brain switching on the moment your eyes close; rewritten around a family group chat warning at the start of Taiwan's ghost month

zh-tw.content:
我媽在家族群組提醒：農曆七月了，晚上不要在外面亂晃。
我沒有在外面晃。
我在床上晃，左邊翻到右邊，右邊再翻回左邊，一整晚在原地移動。
真要說的話，房間裡也沒有比較安全：
這裡有個東西，會把我三年前講錯的一句話拿出來重播，
而且只在我閉上眼睛的時候現身。
zh-tw.editorNote: 農曆七月剛開始、長輩開始在群組叮嚀的時候最好用。適合當作已讀不回之後，發在自己限動的續集。
variations: 長輩叫我七月不要亂晃，可是我晃的範圍只有一張床。
我房間裡真的有東西，牠專門挑我閉眼的時候重播我的黑歷史。

en.content:
Mum posted in the family group chat: it's ghost month, don't wander around at night.
I'm not wandering anywhere.
I'm rolling — left side to right side, right side back to left, covering no distance at all.
Honestly, the room isn't any safer:
something in here replays one sentence I got wrong three years ago,
and it only shows up once I close my eyes.
en.editorNote: For the start of ghost month, when the warnings from your elders start rolling in. Good as the follow-up story after you leave the family chat on read.
variations: Told not to wander at night. My entire range is one mattress.
There really is something in my room. It shows up when I shut my eyes, and it only plays my worst clips.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by 2026 暑假／開學日期整理（暑假 7/1 起、8 月底開學）；改寫成一個把作息往前挪的算術冷笑話，不談課業

zh-tw.content:
開學剩十七天。
每天提早五分鐘睡的話，最後一晚我可以在一點三十五就寢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假最後兩週貼最準，配一張凌晨的鬧鐘截圖。
variations: 我的作息調整計畫每天進步五分鐘，開學那天大概會準時抵達凌晨。
調作息這件事我很認真，只是單位抓錯了。

en.content:
Seventeen days till school starts.
Five minutes earlier each night puts me at a 1:35am bedtime on the last one.
en.editorNote: Best in the final two weeks of summer, with a screenshot of your alarm.
variations: My reset plan gains five minutes a night. By day one I should arrive promptly at 1am.
I am taking this seriously. I just picked the wrong unit.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by a widely shared insomnia joke about never messing up the bed; rewritten as a two-line deadpan line about a permanently tidy bed

zh-tw.content:
我的床永遠很整齊。
不是我勤勞，是我每晚只躺在上面，沒真的睡進去過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被稱讚房間乾淨的時候，用來自首。
variations: 我家最整齊的地方是床，因為它一直沒被用到。
床鋪維持得這麼好，代價是我。

en.content:
My bed is always perfectly made.
Not because I'm tidy. I lie on top of it every night and never actually get in.
en.editorNote: For when someone compliments how neat your room is.
variations: Tidiest thing I own is a bed that never gets used.
The bed looks great. I am the cost of that.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by 115 學年度行事曆整理裡「開學前調整作息」的討論；改寫成搬家比喻的溫柔語錄，不給時數建議、不談醫療

zh-tw.content:
暑假快過完了，你想把作息搬回原本的位置。
搬家不會一天結束，先搬一箱就好。
今晚比昨天早二十分鐘關燈，就算數。
搬不動也沒關係，箱子不會跑掉，明天再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在把生理時鐘往回喬的人。
variations: 作息是用搬的，不是用切換的。
今天只搬得動一箱，那今天就搬那一箱。

en.content:
Summer's nearly over and you want your sleep schedule back where it was.
Moving takes more than one night. Carry one box.
Lights out twenty minutes earlier than yesterday counts.
And if it doesn't happen, the box isn't going anywhere. Tomorrow, then.
en.editorNote: Send it to someone nudging their body clock back a step at a time.
variations: A schedule gets moved, not switched.
One box is what today had in it. That's the box.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by sleep-struggle posts about the brain staging imaginary conversations at night; rewritten as a rehearsal that gets two seconds of screen time

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點半，我在腦袋裡演練一場明天不會發生的對話。
情境是：電梯遇到那位鄰居，他問我最近好不好。
我準備了三個版本，還挑好語氣，順便想了他可能的回應。
隔天早上真的遇到他。
我說：早。
他說：早。
兩秒結束。
那三個版本我先留著，說不定哪天用得上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合演練了一整夜、結果只用到兩個字的隔天。
variations: 我為一句「早」準備了三個版本和兩種語氣。
我的腦袋是一個從來沒有正式演出的劇團。

en.content:
3:30am, rehearsing a conversation that is not going to happen.
The setup: I run into that neighbor in the elevator and he asks how I've been.
Three versions written, tone chosen, his likely replies mapped out.
Next morning I actually ran into him.
I said morning.
He said morning.
Two seconds, done.
I'm keeping all three versions. You never know.
en.editorNote: For the morning after a full night of rehearsal used up in one word.
variations: Three drafts and two tones, all for the word morning.
My brain runs a theater company that has never once opened.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by insomnia threads about replaying an old embarrassing moment nobody else remembers; rewritten as being the last person on guard duty

zh-tw.content:
那件事全世界都忘光了。
只剩我一個人每晚幫它站崗。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給凌晨三點還在替陳年往事守夜的人。
variations: 當事人早就下班了，只有我還在加班。
那件事的觀眾席，這幾年只剩我一個。

en.content:
The whole world forgot that thing years ago.
I'm the only one still showing up for the night shift.
en.editorNote: For anyone standing guard over an old cringe at 3am.
variations: Everyone else clocked out of that memory. I kept the keys.
That moment has one remaining audience member and it's me.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by late-night posts about old memories getting sharper instead of fading; rewritten around the brain adding details that were never there

zh-tw.content:
十五年了，那件事的細節我現在記得比當年還多。
連他的表情，我都自己補上了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜發現記憶越修越完整的時候。
variations: 時間沒有沖淡它，時間在幫它加字幕。
當年只有三秒，現在有導演版。

en.content:
Fifteen years on, I remember more detail than I did back then.
I even filled in the look on his face myself.
en.editorNote: For the night you notice a memory keeps gaining detail.
variations: Time didn't blur it. Time added subtitles.
It lasted three seconds. There is now a director's cut.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by descriptions of intrusive nighttime rumination; rewritten as a short dialogue where the brain agrees it's over but kept a copy

zh-tw.content:
我對自己說：都過去了。
腦袋說：過去了沒錯，我有備份。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給每晚都被自己腦袋反駁的人。
variations: 我按了刪除，我的腦袋按了另存新檔。
事情結案了，但我腦袋自己留了一份。

en.content:
Me: that's ancient history.
My brain: ancient, agreed. I kept a copy.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose brain files an objection every night.
variations: I hit delete. My brain hit save as.
The case is closed. My brain kept the paperwork.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by pieces on cringe attacks causing an involuntary physical noise; rewritten as a delayed reaction arriving years later at 3am

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點，我突然對著天花板「嘖」了一聲。
十二年前的事，現在才發作。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜被自己的回憶弄出聲音的時候。
variations: 有些尷尬的潛伏期，是十二年。
旁邊的人問我怎麼了。我說沒事，真的沒事。

en.content:
3am, and I clicked my tongue at the ceiling out of nowhere.
Something from twelve years ago, finally kicking in.
en.editorNote: For the night an old memory makes you audible.
variations: Some cringe has an incubation period of twelve years.
Someone asked what was wrong. Nothing. Genuinely nothing.

items.sourceNote: Inspired by Taiwanese coverage of revenge bedtime procrastination as a compensation mechanism; rewritten as a second-person accusation about refusing to hand the day over

zh-tw.content:
你今天其實很果決。
中午吃什麼，三十秒解決；那封難回的信，你也回了。
偏偏「幾點睡」這一題，你從十一點卡到現在，
每半小時就跟自己說一次：再一下下。
你不是睡不著，你是捨不得把今天交出去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那種累到不行、卻還是滑到兩點的人。
variations: 白天你什麼都能拍板，只有「現在去睡」這件事，你會拖到天亮。
今天沒有一段時間是你的，所以你把夜晚偷來當補償。

en.content:
You were decisive all day.
Lunch: thirty seconds. That email you'd been dodging: sent.
But "go to bed" has been under review since eleven,
and every half hour you rule the same way — five more minutes.
You're not having trouble sleeping. You just can't bring yourself to hand today over.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's exhausted by midnight and still scrolling at two.
variations: You can settle anything except the question of when to stop being awake.
None of today belonged to you, so you're taking the night as back pay.

items.sourceNote: Informed by sleep-hygiene explainers on how drowsiness arrives in waves and gets reset by activity; rewritten as one specific 10:40pm moment

zh-tw.content:
晚上十點四十，吹風機一關掉，我是真的想睡的。
眼皮很重，走路有點飄，講話開始省略主詞。
我想說先把明天要帶的東西放進包包，
再順手把碗洗一洗、充電線插好。
十一點二十回到床上，那個想睡的我已經不在了。
睡意剛剛來過，只是我當時在忙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種「明明有睡意，卻硬要再多做兩件事」的夜晚。
variations: 我的睡意一天只營業五分鐘，而我每天都在那五分鐘裡洗碗。
那五分鐘是今天唯一的機會，我拿去插充電線了。

en.content:
10:40pm. The second the hair dryer goes off, I genuinely want to sleep.
Eyelids heavy, walking slightly sideways, dropping words out of sentences.
Then I figure I'll pack tomorrow's bag first.
Then the dishes. Then the charger.
11:20, back in bed, and the sleepy version of me has left.
Drowsiness did show up. I was busy.
en.editorNote: For nights when you were sleepy and decided to do two more things first.
variations: My window for sleep is open five minutes a day and I spend it on dishes.
That was today's one chance and I used it on a charging cable.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese health coverage of restless legs at night; rewritten as a first-person body-sensation quote with no medical claims

zh-tw.content:
我的腿今晚不歸我管。
不是痛也不是麻，是一種說不出來的「想動」，
伸直不對，彎起來也不對，交叉撐個三十秒又得換。
上半身早就投降了，膝蓋以下還在原地踏步。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜被自己的腿吵醒、又講不出哪裡不舒服的時候。
variations: 全身都同意要睡了，只有兩條腿投反對票。
我不是翻來覆去，我是被自己的小腿帶著繞場。

en.content:
My legs are not taking orders tonight.
Not pain, not pins and needles — just an unsayable need to move.
Straight is wrong. Bent is wrong. Crossed buys me thirty seconds.
The top half of me surrendered hours ago. Everything below the knee is still marching in place.
en.editorNote: For the night your legs keep you up and you can't describe what's actually wrong.
variations: My whole body voted to sleep. My legs abstained, loudly.
I'm not tossing and turning. I'm being walked around by my own shins.

items.sourceNote: Informed by explainers describing sleep pressure and the body clock as slow processes rather than switches; rewritten as a farming-versus-appliance analogy

zh-tw.content:
睡眠是農作物，不是家電。
家電按下去就會動，不動還可以送修；
作物只能把土翻鬆、水澆好，然後走開，
它哪一天冒出來，你說了不算。
而我每晚做的事，比較像蹲在田邊大聲叫它快點長。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一直覺得「再用力一點就睡得著」的人。
variations: 你可以把燈關掉、把房間弄暗，但你按不到「發芽」那個鍵。
今晚沒收成，不代表這塊田壞掉了。

en.content:
Sleep is a crop, not an appliance.
An appliance runs when you press the button, and you can get it repaired.
A crop gets loosened soil, water, and then you walk away.
What day it comes up is not your call.
What I do every night is closer to squatting at the edge of the field, shouting at it to hurry up.
en.editorNote: For anyone still trying to force sleep by trying harder at it.
variations: You can dim the room. There is no button marked germinate.
A bad harvest tonight doesn't mean the field is broken.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese public-health sleep-hygiene material on bedtime timing; rewritten as a self-deprecating numbers joke with no advice or medical claims

zh-tw.content:
昨天一點才躺下，兩點四十睡著。
今天為了補回來，十點半就洗好澡爬上床。
結果我在黑暗裡躺了四個多小時，比昨天整整多躺一倍。
早睡這件事，我唯一提早的是開始睡不著的時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合下定決心早睡、結果只是提早開始翻身的那一晚。
variations: 提早兩小時上床，等於提早兩小時開始跟天花板聊天。
我把睡覺時間往前挪，睡意沒有跟著搬。

en.content:
Last night I got in bed at one and fell asleep at two forty.
Tonight, to make up for it, I was showered and under the covers by ten thirty.
I then lay in the dark for four hours straight — exactly double.
The only thing I moved earlier was the start time of not sleeping.
en.editorNote: For the night you finally commit to an early bedtime and just start staring earlier.
variations: Going to bed two hours early means two extra hours of talking to the ceiling.
I moved my bedtime up. My sleep did not come with it.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese coverage of nighttime hyperarousal in apartment living; rewritten as a timestamped log of a building's sounds

zh-tw.content:
十二點半，樓上那家的椅子終於不再拖動。
一點四十，隔壁的電視關掉，換成一個人來回走的腳步聲。
三點十五，有人牽車出門，鐵門拉了兩次才對準。
這棟樓每個人的作息我都背得出來，只有我自己那一格是空白的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住公寓、整晚靠聲音陪著過夜的人。
variations: 我不認識這棟樓的任何一個人，但我知道他們幾點回家。
全棟的班表我都排好了，就是排不進自己那一欄。

en.content:
Twelve thirty: the chair upstairs finally stops scraping.
One forty: next door kills the TV and switches to footsteps, back and forth.
Three fifteen: someone wheels a scooter out and the gate takes two tries to line up.
I could recite this building's schedule from memory, and my own row is the only blank one.
en.editorNote: For anyone in an apartment who spends the night keeping tabs on everyone else's.
variations: I don't know a single neighbor, but I know exactly what time they get home.
I've got the whole building's timetable. Mine's the one column I can't fill in.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese explainers on nighttime sympathetic overdrive turning trivia into urgent tasks; rewritten as a comic late-night bookkeeping episode

zh-tw.content:
睡不著就把手機拿起來，點開銀行 App 對這個月的帳。
前面每一筆都對得上，只有八號那筆七十九塊，我怎麼想都想不起來。
翻購物紀錄、翻通話紀錄、最後翻到那天的照片，答案是超商的一顆茶葉蛋加一瓶水。
案子破了，天也快亮了，我為七十九塊加班到四點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜被一件根本不重要的小事整個抓住的時候。
variations: 白天懶得對的帳，半夜會自己找上門，而且非查清楚不可。
沒睡著這件事我解決不了，但那筆七十九塊我一定要給它一個交代。

en.content:
Can't sleep, so I pick up the phone and start reconciling this month's bank app.
Everything lines up except one charge on the 8th: seventy-nine dollars, no memory of it at all.
I dig through order history, then call logs, then that day's photos, and it turns out to be a tea egg and a bottle of water from the convenience store.
Case closed, sun almost up, four hours of overtime for seventy-nine dollars.
en.editorNote: For the night one completely unimportant detail takes you hostage.
variations: The receipt I couldn't be bothered to check at noon comes for me at two.
I can't solve the not-sleeping, but that seventy-nine dollars is going to explain itself.

items.sourceNote: Informed by material on bedtime behavior and effortful sleep attempts; rewritten as a negotiation between present self and tomorrow-morning self

zh-tw.content:
我跟七點的自己開了一場很短的會。
他要求我立刻睡著，理由是他明天要撐滿八小時。
我說我從十一點就在努力了，這裡沒有一個開關可以按下去。
會議沒有共識，兩個人各自散會，一個繼續醒著，一個繼續等著被叫醒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合明天要早起、現在正在跟自己談判的深夜。
variations: 明天的我很生氣，可惜他現在還聯絡不上。
我很想幫他，真的，但這件事我這邊沒有權限。

en.content:
I held a very short meeting with my seven a.m. self.
He demanded I fall asleep immediately, on the grounds that he has eight hours to survive.
I told him I've been trying since eleven and there is no switch on this end to flip.
No agreement was reached, so we adjourned — one of us stays awake, the other keeps waiting to be woken up.
en.editorNote: For the late night spent negotiating with the version of you who has to get up.
variations: Tomorrow-morning me is furious, and unfortunately unreachable right now.
I'd love to help him. I genuinely don't have the permissions.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese reporting on how anticipatory worry about the next day sustains insomnia; rewritten as a gentle second-person reframe with no treatment advice

zh-tw.content:
你正在幫明天寫預告：明天一定廢掉，什麼都做不了。
上一次你這樣預告是上個月的事，隔天你還是把該做的事做完了，只是慢了一點。
明天會怎樣要等明天才知道，現在的你沒有資格代簽。
把筆放下，剩下的交給明天那個人，他比你以為的耐撐。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合躺著開始預告明天有多慘、越想越睡不著的時候。
variations: 你有預告過很多次災難，真正上映的沒有幾部。
現在的你只負責躺著，明天的難不難，讓明天的人去評。

en.content:
You're writing tomorrow's review before tomorrow happens: total write-off, nothing will get done.
Last time you filed that review was a month ago, and the next day you still got through what mattered, just slower.
How tomorrow goes is tomorrow's to report, and you don't have the standing to sign off on it now.
Put the pen down and leave the rest to that guy — he holds up better than you think.
en.editorNote: For the night you start narrating how bad tomorrow will be and wake yourself up doing it.
variations: You've announced a lot of disasters. Very few of them ever opened.
Your only job right now is lying here. Let tomorrow's version rate tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese reporting on tropical nights and how sustained overnight heat wrecks sleep; rewritten as a plain scene with no health claims

zh-tw.content:
把枕頭翻面，涼的那面撐不到十分鐘。
一隻腳伸到被子外面，過一下又自己收回來。
爬起來走到客廳，趴在磁磚地上，臉整個貼著地板。
遙控器就在手邊，我把溫度又往下按了兩格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合夏天夜裡熱到在家裡到處找涼的地方躺的時候。
variations: 磁磚地涼的那一塊，我大概三分鐘就躺完了，只好往旁邊挪。
枕頭兩面都翻過了，現在在等它自己冷回來。

en.content:
I flip the pillow, and the cool side lasts maybe ten minutes.
One foot slides out from under the blanket, then pulls itself back in.
I get up, walk to the living room, and lie face down on the tile floor.
The remote is right by my hand, so I knock the temperature down two more notches.
en.editorNote: For summer nights spent migrating around your own apartment looking for a cold surface.
variations: I used up the cool patch of tile in about three minutes and had to shuffle sideways.
Both sides of the pillow are spent. Now I'm waiting for one to cool back down.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese coverage of a mass online thread where people compared their sleepless nights; rewritten as an original taxonomy joke

zh-tw.content:
我把睡不著的夜晚分成三種。
第一種是躺下去就一路醒著，眼睛閉了四十分鐘還在等。
第二種是睡到一半彈起來，看一眼時鐘才過五十分鐘。
第三種是天都快亮了才睡著，而今晚是第三種。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合失眠到已經能幫自己的夜晚分類編號的時候。
variations: 分類分得這麼熟，代表三種我都很常遇到。
第三種最難處理，因為鬧鐘不會因為你剛睡著就放過你。

en.content:
I've started sorting my bad nights into three kinds.
Kind one is lying down and staying awake the entire way through, eyes shut for forty minutes and still waiting.
Kind two is snapping upright partway through and learning that only fifty minutes have gone by.
Kind three is falling asleep right as the sky turns gray, and tonight is a kind three.
en.editorNote: For when you've had enough sleepless nights to file them into categories.
variations: Knowing the categories this well means I've collected plenty of each.
Kind three is the worst, because the alarm doesn't care that you just got there.

items.sourceNote: Informed by reporting on sleep-regularity research and how irregular schedules push ordinary chores into the small hours; rewritten as an appliance's point of view

zh-tw.content:
我是洗衣機，平常十點就收工。
這幾個禮拜，我常常在一點多被按下去，脫水的時候整台在原地抖。
按我的那隻手不急著等我洗完，人已經回到床上躺著了。
我轉完之後嗶了三聲，沒有人來收衣服。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜找事情做、結果連家電都被拖下水的那種夜晚。
variations: 我嗶完三聲就沒事了，你還要躺到天亮。
凌晨一點半按下開始鍵的人，通常不是為了洗衣服。

en.content:
I'm the washing machine, and I normally clock out around ten.
These past few weeks I keep getting switched on past one in the morning, rattling in place through the spin cycle.
The hand that pressed my button isn't waiting around for me; it's already back in bed.
I beep three times when I finish, and nobody comes to collect the laundry.
en.editorNote: For the nights you invent chores at one in the morning and drag your appliances into it.
variations: My three beeps and I'm done. You're still in there till sunrise.
Nobody starts a load at 1:30 a.m. because of the laundry.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese public-media reporting on sleep difficulty and pre-bed screen habits; rewritten as a gentle second-person reframe with no treatment advice

zh-tw.content:
手先停一下，別去算你今晚還剩幾個小時。
把手機翻過去，螢幕朝下，時間先不歸你管。
腳伸直，肩膀往下沉，讓被子壓住你一點。
你現在的工作就是躺著，剩下的等天亮再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經開始倒數還能睡幾小時、越算越醒的時候。
variations: 螢幕朝下的那一秒，你就少了一個逼自己的理由。
先把肩膀放下來，其他的今晚都不必決定。

en.content:
Hold off for a moment before you count how many hours you have left tonight.
Turn the phone over, screen down, and let the clock stop being yours to manage.
Straighten your legs, let your shoulders drop, and let the blanket press on you a little.
Lying here is the whole job right now, and the rest can wait for daylight.
en.editorNote: For the point where counting your remaining hours has become the thing keeping you up.
variations: The second that screen goes face down, you lose one way to pressure yourself.
Shoulders down first. Nothing else has to be decided tonight.

items.sourceNote: Informed by clinical writing on the sleep-effort paradox (trying harder to sleep raises arousal); reframed as a self-questioning line with no medical claims

zh-tw.content:
問我今晚在等什麼，我會說在等睏意來。
真正的答案是我在等一個許可，等有人告訴我今天到這裡就可以了。
睏意早就在門口站了很久，是我遲遲不肯去簽收。
那張單子上的名字，只有我自己填得下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合躺著卻覺得自己還沒資格結束今天的那種夜晚。
variations: 我在等的東西，比睏意更難自己出現。
今天到這裡就好了，這句話得自己對自己說。

en.content:
Ask me what I'm waiting for tonight and I'll say I'm waiting to get sleepy.
The real answer is that I'm waiting for permission, for someone to tell me today is allowed to be over.
Sleepiness has been standing at the door for hours, and I'm the one refusing to sign for it.
Nobody else can put a name on that slip.
en.editorNote: For nights when you're lying down but still feel like you haven't earned the right to end the day.
variations: I was never waiting to get tired. I was waiting to be let go.
Today is allowed to be over. You have to say that one to yourself.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese reporting on a viral collective-insomnia morning; rewritten from a bystander's point of view, no quoted material

zh-tw.content:
兩點半，冰箱先醒，嗡一聲，過一下又自己安靜下去。
三點四十，樓下有台機車發不動，催了三次才走。
四點多，牆裡的水管響了一下，有人比我更早起床。
五點十分，第一隻鳥開口，接著整排都跟上。
六點，垃圾車的音樂從巷口慢慢繞過來。
我一次都沒睡著，可是這一夜，是我親耳聽完的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合天快亮還躺著、乾脆一路數聲音等天亮的那種夜晚。
variations: 天亮不是看見的，是聽見的。
冰箱先醒，再來是機車，最後才輪到鳥。

en.content:
2:30 — the fridge kicks on, hums a while, shuts itself up again.
3:40 — somebody downstairs cranks a scooter three times before it catches.
Sometime past four, a pipe knocks inside the wall. Someone's up before me.
5:10 — one bird starts, then the whole row piles on.
6:00 — the garbage truck's jingle comes winding up the lane.
I never fell asleep once, but I heard this entire night through, start to finish.
en.editorNote: For the nights you give up on sleeping and just track the sounds until it gets light.
variations: You don't watch the morning arrive. You hear it.
Fridge first, then the scooters, then the birds.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taipei health-bureau guidance on wind-down routines and pre-sleep screens; turned into a playful non-dictionary definition, no advice given

zh-tw.content:
關燈的定義，是把一整天的音量調到剩下自己一個人的聲音。
燈滅之後，房間會慢慢把白天沒處理完的事一件一件搬回來。
你以為那叫安靜，量起來卻比會議室還吵。
所以有些人會留一盞小燈，為的是有東西陪著自己一起醒著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合手一按開關、腦袋反而整個開機的那一秒。
variations: 房間暗下來的時候，腦袋才正式開始上班。
留一盞小燈的人，通常不是怕黑。

en.content:
Here's what "lights out" really means: turning the whole day's volume down until the only voice left is yours.
Once the room goes dark, it starts carrying back every unfinished thing from the day, one at a time.
You'd call that quiet, but measure it and it's louder than any conference room.
Which is why some people leave a small lamp on, so something else in the room is awake with them.
en.editorNote: For the exact second you flip the switch and your brain boots up instead.
variations: The room going dark is when my head clocks in.
People who leave a lamp on are usually not scared of the dark.

items.sourceNote: Informed by research on paradoxical intention for insomnia (sleepiness arriving once effort stops); written as an inevitable near-future scene, no treatment claims

zh-tw.content:
再過大概四十分鐘，天會開始有一點灰。
巷口會先有一台送報的機車經過，接著是隔壁的鐵門被拉開。
那時候你會突然覺得睏，而且睏得非常誠懇，比整夜任何一刻都誠懇。
鬧鐘會在二十分鐘之後響，你們剛好在半路上錯過彼此。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經放棄睡覺、開始等天亮的那段時間。
variations: 睏意每次都挑鬧鐘前二十分鐘才到。
整夜最好睡的那二十分鐘，永遠排在起床前面。

en.content:
In about forty minutes the sky will start going a little grey.
A scooter will turn into the alley with the papers, and then the shutter next door will roll up.
That's when the sleepiness finally shows up, and it'll be the most sincere it has been all night.
Your alarm goes off twenty minutes after that, and the two of you miss each other by exactly that much.
en.editorNote: For the stretch where you've given up on sleeping and started waiting for sunrise instead.
variations: Sleepiness always arrives twenty minutes before the alarm.
The best twenty minutes of sleep all night are always the ones right before you get up.

items.sourceNote: Informed by a patient-community piece on how the same body behaves differently depending on where it is waiting; rewritten as a clinic waiting area versus own bed comparison, no advice or treatment content

zh-tw.content:
下午在診所的排椅上，我等著護理師把我的名字念出來，一等就是五十分鐘。
那五十分鐘我幾乎沒有感覺，翻完兩本捲了角的舊雜誌，抬頭剛好聽到自己。
晚上躺回床上，我等的是另一個東西來叫我，同樣長度的五十分鐘我數了三次。
白天那個地方至少有人負責念名字，我這裡的隊伍沒有人在管，只能自己站著往前挪。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合白天在哪裡都撐得住、一躺下卻開始等的人。
variations: 在候診區等五十分鐘很快，在床上等五十分鐘要分三次數。
白天有人會念到我的名字，晚上這一段沒有人負責叫號。

en.content:
This afternoon I sat in the row of hard chairs at the clinic, waiting for someone to call my name, and it took fifty minutes.
I barely felt those fifty minutes — two curled-up magazines later, I looked up right as my name came out of the speaker.
At night I lie down and wait for something else to call me, and the same fifty minutes get counted three separate times.
The afternoon at least had a person whose whole job was saying my name; this line has nobody running it, so I just shuffle forward on my own.
en.editorNote: For anyone who can hold out anywhere during the day and starts waiting the second they lie down.
variations: Fifty minutes in a waiting room goes fast. Fifty minutes in bed gets counted three times.
Someone calls my name in the afternoon. Nobody is working the night shift.

items.sourceNote: Informed by a roundup of relatable insomnia posts about racing thoughts at night; rewritten as a daytime study-room scene where the same small sorting gesture repeats, no advice given

zh-tw.content:
早上十點，我在自習室最角落那張桌子，把同一段話讀到第四遍。
讀到一半我停下來，用手指把桌面上的橡皮擦屑推成一小堆，推得非常整齊。
隔壁的人翻了一頁，我又把那一小堆重新推了一次。
昨天凌晨三點我做過一模一樣的動作，只是推的是腦子裡的東西，一件一件推到天亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合整夜沒睡、隔天還得假裝自己在讀書的那種早上。
variations: 我讀不進去的時候，手會自己找事情做。
白天推橡皮擦屑，半夜推的是別的東西。

en.content:
Ten in the morning, corner desk of the study room, reading the same paragraph for the fourth time.
Halfway through I stop and push the eraser crumbs on the desk into one tidy little pile with my finger.
The person next to me turns a page, so I push the pile back together again.
At three this morning I was doing the exact same thing, except the pile was made of thoughts and I kept sorting it until the sky went light.
en.editorNote: For the morning after a night with no sleep, when you still have to look like you are studying.
variations: When I cannot read, my hands go find something to organize.
Eraser crumbs by day, everything else at three in the morning.

items.sourceNote: Informed by background on Taiwanese night markets running from evening into the small hours; rewritten as a timestamped log of one stall closing down while the narrator stays out, no advice content

zh-tw.content:
21:50　油鍋還在滾，隊伍長到擋住隔壁攤的招牌。
23:20　賣衣服的那攤先收，鐵架一節一節疊回推車上。
00:40　最後一組客人把塑膠椅推回原位，老闆開始刷那口鍋。
01:30　整條街剩下兩盞燈，地上的水漬把光拉得很長。
02:10　推車推走了，原本的位置留下一塊方形的乾地板。
03:00　我還站在那塊乾地板旁邊，沒有要去哪裡的意思。
04:05　回到家，沒開燈，坐在床邊把外套一顆一顆解開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種寧願在外面待到最後、也不想太早回房間的夜晚。
variations: 夜市都收完了，我還在那個路口研究地板。
整條街的燈都關了，只有我的行程還沒排完。

en.content:
21:50 — the fryer is still going and the queue is blocking the sign of the stall next door.
23:20 — the clothes stall packs up first, steel racks folding back onto the cart one section at a time.
00:40 — the last group pushes the plastic stools back into place and the owner starts scrubbing the wok.
01:30 — two lights left on the whole street, and the wet patches on the ground stretch them out long.
02:10 — the cart rolls away and leaves behind one neat dry rectangle of pavement.
03:00 — I am still standing next to that dry rectangle with nowhere I intend to be.
04:05 — home, lights off, sitting on the edge of the bed undoing my jacket one button at a time.
en.editorNote: For nights when staying out until the very end beats going back to your room early.
variations: The whole market packed up and I am still at the corner studying the pavement.
Every light on the street is off and my schedule somehow is not finished.

items.sourceNote: Informed by a collection of hardware-store joke setups where a customer asks for an impossible part; rewritten as a Taiwanese hardware shop special-order slip, no advice or product claims

zh-tw.content:
品項：一顆螺絲。
規格：不用太長，能把後腦勺那塊會鬆開的板子鎖回去就好。
數量：一顆，再備一顆。
用途：那塊板子每天過了十一點就會自己彈開，裡面的東西整晚掉個不停。
希望取貨時間：今天，天黑之前。
備註（店家填）：這個尺寸要調貨，最快下週三；先拿一條束帶回去撐著，這種撐法我們賣得很好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合想把腦袋鎖起來、卻只能先撐著過一晚的時候。
variations: 我想訂一顆螺絲，鎖住每天十一點會自己彈開的那塊板子。
缺的那個零件要調貨，今晚只能先用一條束帶撐著。

en.content:
Item: one screw.
Spec: does not need to be long, just enough to hold down the panel at the back of my head that keeps coming loose.
Quantity: one, plus a spare.
Purpose: the panel pops open by itself every night after eleven and everything inside falls out until morning.
Pickup: today, before dark.
Shop notes: that size has to be ordered in, Wednesday at the earliest — take a cable tie for now, we sell a lot of them to people holding things together overnight.
en.editorNote: For when you want to bolt your head shut and all you get is something to hold it together for one night.
variations: I would like to order one screw, for the panel that pops open every night at eleven.
The part I need is out of stock, so tonight is being held together with a cable tie.

items.sourceNote: Informed by reporting on Taiwanese self-service car washes switching to timed unlimited-use pricing and staying open around the clock, plus background that 處暑 falls on 8/23 with hot days and widening day-night temperature gaps; rewritten as an on-site weather bulletin, no product or health claims

zh-tw.content:
本場區今夜天氣：三號車道空著，泡沫濃度偏高。
高壓水柱間歇性出現，能見度取決於你手抖的程度。
地面積水偏深，穿拖鞋來的請自行負責。
車身約三十分鐘轉乾，車主本人不在本預報範圍內。
明天進處暑，白天照樣三十五度，入夜後溫差開始拉大。
附註：投幣口只收十元，睡意不收，請不要硬塞。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜沒事做、開車出門只為了找個地方站著的時候。
variations: 車三十分鐘就乾了，我大概要到天亮。
投幣口只收十元，我這一整晚的清醒它不收。

en.content:
Tonight at this car wash: bay three is open, foam density running high.
Pressure hose intermittent, visibility depending on how steady your hand is.
Standing water is deeper than it looks, flip-flops entirely at your own risk.
Bodywork dries in about thirty minutes; the owner of the car falls outside this forecast.
Heat holds tomorrow, with the gap between afternoon and midnight getting wider all week.
Note: the slot takes ten-dollar coins only. It does not take being wide awake, so please stop feeding it that.
en.editorNote: For nights you drive out just to have somewhere to stand.
variations: The car dries in thirty minutes. I am looking at sunrise.
The coin slot takes ten-dollar coins and none of my extra hours.

items.sourceNote: Informed by official Taiwanese freeway closure notices for late-August overnight ramp construction (22:00 to 06:00 the next morning); rewritten as a traffic bulletin for an imaginary detour, no real place names copied verbatim

zh-tw.content:
路況播報，這裡是你腦內那條替代道路。
南下的出口今晚封閉施工，要等到明天早上六點才會開放。
改道後會經過三年前那場沒講完的對話，路面顛簸，請減速。
沿線沒有照明，導航播到這一段會自己安靜下來。
目前查無更早的出口，天亮以前只能繼續開。
播報完畢，後座那位已經睡著了，開穩一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合腦子整晚繞路、怎麼開都下不了交流道的夜晚。
variations: 今晚的出口封閉施工，六點才開放，我先繞一下。
導航開到這一段就安靜了，因為它也沒去過。

en.content:
Traffic bulletin, coming to you from the detour inside your head.
The southbound exit is closed for overnight work and will not reopen until six.
The detour runs past a conversation you left unfinished three years ago; surface is rough, please slow down.
No lighting along that stretch, and your navigation goes quiet the moment you enter it.
No earlier exit is currently listed, so you drive until it gets light.
End of bulletin. The one in the back seat is already asleep, so keep it steady.
en.editorNote: For nights your head keeps circling and no exit shows up.
variations: Exit closed for overnight work, reopening at six. Taking the long way.
The navigation goes quiet on that stretch because it has never been there either.

items.sourceNote: Informed by coverage of Taiwan's sleep-aid prescription volume and late-night pharmacy habits; rewritten as a counter conversation with no medication named and no advice given

zh-tw.content:
「你好，我想找那種吃了會想睡的。」
「有喔。不過先問一下，你是睡不著，還是不想睡？」
「⋯⋯這兩個差在哪裡？」
「差在後面那個，我這裡沒有東西可以給你。」
「那你有什麼？」
「我有找你的零錢，還有一句『路上小心，早點回去』。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合深夜還在外面晃、其實只是想跟誰講兩句話的時候。
variations: 「你是睡不著，還是不想睡？」這題我答不出來。
他找我零錢，順便說了一句早點回去，我就在門口站了很久。

en.content:
"Hi, I'm looking for the kind of thing that makes you sleepy."
"Sure. Quick question first — can't sleep, or don't want to sleep?"
"...What's the difference?"
"The difference is I have nothing on the shelf for the second one."
"So what do you have?"
"Your change, and a get home safe."
en.editorNote: For late nights when you're out mostly to hear another person's voice.
variations: "Can't sleep, or don't want to sleep?" I had no answer ready.
He handed me my change and a get home safe, and I stood outside a while.

items.sourceNote: Informed by hospital coverage of rising chronic insomnia rates in Taiwan and repeated night-time waking; rewritten as a monologue from a motion-sensor light, no clinical claims

zh-tw.content:
我是你家玄關那盞感應燈，白天沒人理我，我覺得這樣很好。
你這禮拜有四個晚上在天亮前經過我，一次是去倒水，另外三次走到門口又轉身回房間。
我從來不問你在找什麼，我的工作只有一項：你靠近的時候先亮起來。
哪天你整夜都沒經過我，我會在黑暗裡站一整晚，然後偷偷替你高興。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個總是半夜起來走動、卻說自己睡得還可以的人。
variations: 玄關的燈這禮拜亮了四次，每次都只有我一個人。
它不問我在找什麼，只是在我走近的時候先亮起來。

en.content:
I'm the motion-sensor light in your entryway, ignored all day, which suits me fine.
Four nights this week you walked past me before sunrise — once for water, three times you got to the door and turned back.
I never ask what you're looking for; my whole job is to come on before you reach me.
On the night you don't pass me at all, I'll stand in the dark the whole time and be quietly glad.
en.editorNote: Send it to the person who paces at night and insists they slept fine.
variations: The hallway light came on four times this week, always for one person.
It never asks what I'm looking for. It just comes on before I get there.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese clinic material on how poor sleep shows up as daytime slowness and blank spells; rewritten as a two-person exchange at a night market stall, no clinical or medication content

zh-tw.content:
「太陽都還沒下山，你就先垮了，昨天又整晚沒睡？」
「還沒垮，我只是在等我的胃醒過來。」
「老闆剛剛叫你三次，你盯著那鍋油看到人家喊第四次。」
「那些泡泡一直在動，看起來比我有精神。」
「先坐下啦，這攤我請，你負責把它吃完就好。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合朋友明明累到站不穩還硬撐的時候，傳過去當作「坐下來吃東西」的邀請。
variations: 「你今天講話慢了半拍。」「我在等我的胃醒過來。」
那鍋油裡的泡泡，今天看起來比我有精神。

en.content:
"The sun's still up and you're already fading — no sleep again last night?"
"Nothing's fading yet, I'm waiting for my stomach to wake up."
"The owner called your order three times, and you stared into that fryer until the fourth."
"The bubbles keep moving, and they look livelier than I do."
"Sit down already — this one's on me, you just have to finish it."
en.editorNote: For the friend who is visibly running on empty in broad daylight and insists on staying upright.
variations: "You're half a beat behind today." "I'm waiting for my stomach to wake up."
The bubbles in that fryer have more energy than I do today.

items.sourceNote: Informed by Taiwanese material on sleep disturbance and next-day attention lapses; rewritten as an observation across a hotpot table that turns out to be a reflection, no clinical claims

zh-tw.content:
中午的火鍋店，鍋邊那個人整頓飯只做一件事，湯一滾就撈，撈起來又放回去。
別人講話他都有點頭，可是眼睛跟著蒸氣往上飄，飄到一半就停在那裡。
店員來加湯的時候他嚇了一大跳，肩膀整個彈起來，同桌的人笑他反應太誇張。
我低頭去撈自己掉進去的湯匙，才看清楚那個人一直長在不鏽鋼鍋緣上，我動他就動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配一張午餐火鍋照，回應整桌都在問你「今天怎麼特別安靜」。
variations: 他從頭到尾只顧著撈，好像鍋裡有什麼東西要救。
不鏽鋼鍋緣上那張臉，我動他就動。

en.content:
Hotpot at noon, and the person over on the rim spent the whole meal on one task: scooping the second it boiled, then putting it back.
He nodded whenever anyone spoke, but his eyes drifted up with the steam and stopped halfway.
When the server came to top up the broth he jolted, shoulders and all, and the table laughed at how big the reaction was.
I leaned in to fish out my own dropped spoon, and that was when I saw him living on the steel rim, moving whenever I moved.
en.editorNote: A caption for the lunch photo when everyone at the table asks why you're so quiet today.
variations: He scooped all through lunch like something in there needed rescuing.
That face on the steel rim moves whenever I move.

items.sourceNote: Informed by research on accumulated sleep debt and its daytime carryover at work; rewritten as a borrowing-and-returning register kept in a hypermarket freezer aisle, no medical guidance

zh-tw.content:
冷凍櫃前借還登記，記錄人：站在這裡第七分鐘、被白霧凍到腳踝的我。
八月十九日：借走四個小時，借的人是那天半夜的我，到今天沒還。
八月二十日：借走「好好聽別人把話講完」的能力，中午自己回來一半。
八月二十一日：借走一句「今天一定早點睡」，說完就找不到了。
八月二十二日：借走白天的胃口，晚上原封不動放回來，已經冷掉。
今天：借冷凍櫃的冷氣，用來把眼睛凍醒，預計三分鐘後歸還。
歸還欄：這一頁還是空的，簽名的地方只有我一個人的字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合白天在賣場、超市晃很久卻什麼都沒買的時候發，配一張冷凍櫃的照片。
variations: 借走四個小時，借的人是那天半夜的我，到今天沒還。
我站在冷凍櫃前第七分鐘，借的是冷氣，用來把眼睛凍醒。

en.content:
Lending record, freezer aisle, kept by the one who has stood here seven minutes with cold fog around his ankles.
Aug 19: four hours borrowed by the version of me still awake past midnight, outstanding to this day.
Aug 20: borrowed the ability to hear someone finish a sentence, half of it wandered back by lunch.
Aug 21: borrowed the line about getting an early night, lost it somewhere between saying it and meaning it.
Aug 22: borrowed the daytime appetite, returned untouched in the evening, gone cold.
Today: borrowing cold air off the freezer to shock my eyes open, due back in three minutes.
Returns column: still an empty page, and the signature line carries one person's handwriting.
en.editorNote: Post it after a long daytime wander around the supermarket that ends with nothing in the cart.
variations: Four hours borrowed by the version of me awake past midnight, outstanding to this day.
Seven minutes at the freezer door, borrowing cold air to shock my eyes open.

items.sourceNote: Informed by sleep-education coverage of tired eyes focusing less precisely; rewritten as a hypothetical monologue in an optical shop's refraction room, no treatment or medication content

zh-tw.content:
驗光室裡，鏡片一片一片換過去，驗光師問我一還是二比較清楚，我兩個都覺得有點糊。
如果我昨天十一點就把燈關掉，如果我沒有把整夜拿去重播那件早就過去的事，這排字現在應該會乾乾脆脆地站好。
如果真是那樣，我會在這張椅子上很有把握地選第二個，然後笑著走出去挑一副新的鏡框。
驗光師沒有問我昨天睡得好不好，他只是把燈調暗一點，說我們再看一次，慢慢來沒關係。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合白天做完一件簡單的事卻覺得自己特別鈍的時候，傳給懂的人。
variations: 一還是二比較清楚，我兩個都覺得有點糊。
他把燈調暗一點，說我們再看一次，慢慢來沒關係。

en.content:
In the refraction room the lenses click past one at a time, and when he asks whether one or two is clearer, both look a little soft to me.
If I had turned the light off at eleven last night, if I had spent those hours on anything other than replaying something long finished, that row of letters would be standing up straight right now.
If that were the case, I would pick the second one from this chair without hesitating, then walk out grinning and choose new frames.
He never asks how I slept; he just dims the room a little and says we'll look again, no rush.
en.editorNote: For the day when a simple errand leaves you feeling unusually slow, sent to someone who gets it.
variations: One or two, clearer? Both of them look a little soft to me.
He dimmed the room a little and said we'll look again, no rush.

items.sourceNote: FTNN 報導：網友清晨在 Threads 發文問「今天台灣人集體失眠？」引發大量共鳴，許多人四五點就醒著

zh-tw.content:
你以前總說這家的奶茶太甜，可是每次都自己多加一包糖。
現在我六點就坐在這裡，因為那張床昨晚整夜都沒收留我。
老闆娘還是會問「今天兩份嗎」，我每次都要停半秒才想好要怎麼回。
蛋餅切成兩半，一半推到盤子邊，我知道不會有人來吃，我還是推了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個已經離開你的生活、卻還留在你早餐習慣裡的人；也適合自己存著不傳。
variations: 蛋餅切成兩半，一半永遠留在盤子的那一邊。
六點就到早餐店，是因為那張床整夜都沒收留我。

en.content:
You always said the milk tea here was too sweet, and then you'd add another packet of sugar anyway.
I'm sitting here at six now, because that bed didn't take me in all night.
The owner still asks whether it's two orders today, and I still need half a second to work out how to answer.
I cut the egg roll in half and push one half to the edge of the plate. Nobody is coming for it. I push it anyway.
en.editorNote: For someone who left a hole in your morning routine, or for the version of this you never actually send.
variations: I cut it in half out of habit, and half of it just sits there.
Six in the morning at the breakfast shop, because the bed gave up on me first.

items.sourceNote: 自由時報報導 MIT 研究：睡眠不足恍神時反應變慢甚至完全沒反應，大腦啟動類似沖洗的清理機制

zh-tw.content:
月台上有人朝我這邊揮手，我抬起手也跟著揮了回去。
手還舉在半空，那個人就從我旁邊走過去，抱住站在我後面的短髮女生。
就那麼一下，我才發現自己把整個早上僅剩的力氣，用在一個不屬於我的動作上。
我把手放下來假裝在撥頭髮，車廂門剛好在我面前打開。
整夜沒睡的人，連判斷誰在看自己都會失準。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合通勤路上突然懷疑自己判斷力的早晨；貼給同樣一夜沒睡還是得出門的人。
variations: 我揮回去的那隻手，最後只能假裝在撥頭髮。
整夜沒睡，連誰在看自己都會看錯。

en.content:
Someone on the platform waved in my direction, so I lifted my hand and waved back.
My arm was still up when he walked right past me and hugged the woman standing behind me.
In that split second I realized I had spent the last of my morning energy on a gesture that was never mine.
I lowered my hand and pretended to fix my hair, just as the train doors opened in front of me.
After a night with no sleep, even reading who is looking at you comes out wrong.
en.editorNote: For the commute after a sleepless night, when your judgment shows up a beat late.
variations: The hand I waved back with ended up pretending to fix my hair.
No sleep, and suddenly you can't tell who is looking at you.

items.sourceNote: 中時報導：恍神不代表懶惰，研究指出大腦在極度缺乏睡眠時會試圖短暫進入類似睡眠的狀態

zh-tw.content:
為什麼要挑最後面那排的位子？因為在那裡闔上眼睛也不會有人回頭看。
為什麼在這裡就撐不住？因為這兩個小時裡，沒有一件事需要我負責。
那房間裡呢？我想了一整晚也只想出一句：房間裡剩下的全部都是我要處理的。
字幕跑完，燈慢慢亮起來，我是全場最後起身的那個，門邊的工作人員沒有催我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種只有在不用負責的地方才闔得上眼的日子；寫下來只為了描述，不為了解決什麼。
variations: 坐在那排位子上闔上眼睛，沒有人會回頭看。
為什麼在這裡撐不住？因為這兩個小時我什麼都不用負責。

en.content:
Why did I pick a seat in the very back? Because nobody turns around if my eyes close there.
Why can't I stay awake here? Because for two hours, nothing in this room is mine to handle.
And in my own bedroom? I spent a whole night on that one and got as far as: everything left in there is mine to handle.
The credits finish, the lights come up slowly, I'm the last person on my feet, and the staff by the door doesn't hurry me.
en.editorNote: For days when your eyes only close in places where nothing is your responsibility. A description, not a fix.
variations: Nobody turns around if your eyes close back there.
Two hours where nothing in the room is mine to handle.

items.sourceNote: 鏡週刊報導：台灣清晨集體失眠潮，網友分享自己平常睡到九點、那天卻四五點就醒來

zh-tw.content:
六年前在同一個廳，我是被拱上台唱歌的那個，唱完還撐到甜湯上桌才走。
今天我坐在同一張圓桌的角落，看轉盤上那盤菜轉過去又轉回來，一口都沒夾。
親戚問我最近好不好，我說很好，只是睡得比較淺，講完覺得這句話包不住那麼多個晚上。
新人敬酒敬到我們這桌，我起身的動作慢了半拍，杯子舉到一半才想起來要笑。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合喜宴、同學會這種「以前的你也在場」的場合；貼給知道你這幾年怎麼過的人。
variations: 六年前我撐到甜湯上桌，今天我撐到敬酒就滿了。
同一張圓桌，同一個我，差別藏在這幾年的晚上。

en.content:
Six years ago, in this same banquet hall, I was the one they pushed onstage to sing, and I stayed until the dessert soup came out.
Today I'm in the corner of the same round table, watching a dish rotate away and come back without taking any of it.
A relative asks how I've been and I say fine, just sleeping lightly lately, a sentence far too small for the number of nights it has to cover.
When the couple reaches our table for the toast, I get up half a beat late and remember to smile with my glass already halfway up.
en.editorNote: For weddings and reunions where an earlier version of you is also in the room.
variations: Six years ago I lasted until dessert. Today I barely last until the toast.
Same round table, same me, different set of nights behind it.

items.sourceNote: PTT Salary 板夜班保全心得串（哨所巡完就是自己的時間、最難的是把作息調回來）；改寫成三次進值班室的體感遞進，人物與情節全部重寫

zh-tw.content:
第一次接下夜班保全室的鑰匙，我把那排監視畫面當成一部沒有劇情的電影，兩點多開始數牆上的裂痕。
第二次進來值班，我已經學會把椅子調到能靠著、又不至於真的闔眼的角度，天亮前那段變得好過一點。
第三次坐在同一張桌子後面，我才認清深夜其實好過得多，難的是交完班回到家、外面天已經亮透，我卻還睜著眼睛。
夜班沒把我練成不睏的人，只把我的睏意整批挪到錯的時段。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合輪大夜、或作息長期跟別人相反的人，用來回覆「你不是很習慣熬夜了嗎」這種問句。也適合貼在下班回家卻睡不著的那個早晨。
variations: 值班的時候我很清醒，回到家反而變成一台關不掉的機器。
我的熬夜功力普通，睏意的班表倒是排得很有創意。

en.content:
The first night I got the keys to the guard room, the wall of monitors played like a film with no plot, and by two I was counting cracks in the paint.
By the second shift I'd learned exactly how far to tilt the chair, leaning back without actually closing my eyes, and the last stretch before sunrise went easier.
By the third, I'd worked out that the small hours were the easy part. The hard part is getting home after handover, with the street already bright, and lying there wide awake.
Nights never trained the tiredness out of me. They just moved the whole lot of it to the wrong shift.
en.editorNote: For anyone on permanent nights, or living on the opposite schedule from everyone they know. Good reply to 'aren't you used to it by now?'
variations: On shift I'm sharp. At home I'm a machine with no off switch.
My all-nighter skills are average. My sleepiness keeps a very creative roster.

items.sourceNote: 巴哈姆特職場甘苦談「保全一年心得（夜班較多）」討論串裡交接班與作息顛倒的抱怨；改寫成一段交接對話，內容全新

zh-tw.content:
「你眼睛紅成這樣，昨天又沒睡？」交班的大哥推開夜班保全室的門，把鑰匙串擱在桌上。
「我上班的時候很清醒，是下班才睡不著。」
「那你回去躺著都在幹嘛？」
「數天花板的紋路，順便回憶三年前講錯的一句話。」
「所以你在這裡撐，回家也在撐。」
「對，我一天有兩個班，只有一個領得到錢。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合輪班族在交接時間發的自嘲，也很適合貼給同樣「下班比上班還累」的同事，當作互相認領的暗號。
variations: 上班撐著不睡，下班撐著想睡，我一天其實排了兩個班。
值完班還要值一場沒有薪水的班，就是我的行程表。

en.content:
"Your eyes are wrecked. No sleep again?" The guy taking over pushes open the night guard room door and drops the keyring on the desk.
"I'm wide awake on shift. It's after work that I can't sleep."
"So what do you do lying there?"
"Read the ceiling. Revisit one sentence I got wrong three years ago."
"So you're grinding here, then grinding at home."
"Right. I work two shifts a day. Only one of them pays."
en.editorNote: For shift workers to post at handover, or to send to the coworker whose day off is somehow more exhausting than their shift.
variations: Awake on the clock, awake off it. That's two shifts, one paycheck.
Clocking out just moves me to the unpaid shift.

items.sourceNote: FTNN 報導 Threads 上「今天台灣人集體失眠？」貼文引發共鳴，留言出現「睡眠伺服器斷線」的說法；改寫成第一人稱情境，用語與例子全部重寫

zh-tw.content:
清晨五點滑開手機，同一分鐘裡有一整排陌生人在說自己睡不著。
我本來以為只有我這台壞掉，結果整個伺服器都斷線了。
底下有人說已經把衣服洗好晾完，有人說正在看今年第二次的日出。
我沒有因此比較好睡，但至少知道這條半夜的路上，卡住的車不只一台。
zh-tw.editorNote: 凌晨在社群看到一堆人同時哀號失眠時，用這則加入話題；也適合當作限動配文，收集同一時區的難友。
variations: 凌晨的社群比白天熱鬧，因為失眠的人都準時上線。
我以為只有自己壞掉，打開手機才發現是整批的。

en.content:
Five in the morning, I open my phone and a whole column of strangers is posting that they can't sleep either.
I'd assumed I was the only unit malfunctioning. Turns out the entire server dropped.
One person has already done a load of laundry. Another is watching their second sunrise of the year.
It didn't make me sleep any better, but at least the traffic jam has other cars in it.
en.editorNote: For those nights when your feed fills up with people awake at the same hour. Works as a story caption to find your fellow non-sleepers.
variations: The internet is busiest at 4am because that's when the insomniacs clock in.
Thought I was the only broken one. Turns out it was a whole batch.

items.sourceNote: 2026 睡眠焦慮調查文中提到助眠保健品與各式助眠小物在社群爆紅的現象；改寫成個人採購史的自嘲，不提任何產品名稱、不給任何醫療建議

zh-tw.content:
床頭那格抽屜慢慢變成助眠小物的常設展區，香氛噴霧、遮光眼罩、會放海浪聲的小喇叭，全是某個睡不著的深夜下單的。
香氛噴完躺下，我聞到的只有自己很努力的味道；眼罩戴上以後世界確實黑了，我的腦袋卻自作主張開了一盞燈。
三樣東西同時運作的夜裡，房間像個小型展場，而我是唯一還醒著的參觀者。
真正讓我一覺到天亮的，是某個忘記帶手機出門的午後，回家累到連躺姿都懶得挑。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在購物車裡又多一樣助眠小物時發，也可以回覆推薦你「這個超好睡」的朋友，當成溫和的自首。
variations: 我床頭的助眠裝備比我的睡眠時數還多。
買了一整套助眠道具，最後救我的是一個沒帶手機的下午。

en.content:
The drawer by my bed has quietly become a permanent exhibition of sleep gadgets: a pillow spray, a blackout eye mask, a little speaker that plays waves, all of it ordered in the middle of some sleepless night.
I mist the spray, lie down, and the only thing I can smell is how hard I'm trying; the mask makes the world go properly dark, and my brain switches on a lamp of its own.
On nights when all three are running, the room is a tiny trade show and I'm the only visitor still awake.
What finally knocked me out was an afternoon I left my phone at home and came back too tired to even pick a sleeping position.
en.editorNote: For when yet another sleep gadget lands in your cart, or as a gentle confession to the friend who swore this one would work.
variations: My nightstand has more sleep equipment than I have hours of sleep.
Bought the whole sleep kit. Got saved by one phoneless afternoon.
